Lessons.Title: Solving Systems with Gaussian Elimination
ExplanationParagraphs: Represent equations as augmented [A|b] with aligned variables.
Swap rows, scale a row by nonzero, add a multiple of another row.
Zero pivot may require row swap.
A redundant row may leave free variables.
Apply augmented matrices to finance and three-unknown applications.
Independent Cool-down: demonstrate a valid example of the section's central operation and check exact answer.
